cohort: 120 pregnant women with oligohydramnios (amniotic fluid index <=5cm) at >34 weeks gestation and 120 pregnant women with normal amniotic fluid index (8-24 cm) at >34 weeks gestation.
finding: Pregnancies complicated by oligohydramnios at or beyond 34 weeks of gestation are associated with increased rates of non-reactive NST, FHR decelerations during labor, fetal distress, cesarean delivery, and low birth weight.
birth_weight: Mean birth weight was 2.4kg in the oligohydramnios group and 2.9 kg in the control group; 61.67% of infants in the oligohydramnios group had birth weight <2.5 kg compared to 17.5% in the control group.
